display.purpose: Page titles and hero headings only. Instrument Serif with tight negative tracking.

headline.purpose: Section headings, modal titles. Instrument Serif.

title.purpose: Card titles, sub-section labels. Instrument Serif. Often set at medium weight (500) inside cards.

body.purpose: All prose content. DM Sans. Max line length 65-75ch at layout level.

label.purpose: Button labels, form labels, navigation items, badge text. DM Sans medium. The UI workhorse.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Card resting shadow. Always present; signals layer above page, not interactive state.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Tight utility shadow for small floated elements: tooltips, inline chips.

motion.name: ease-out-fast
motion.purpose: Button hover, color state changes. Snappy feedback.

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: Fade in, page transitions. Default easing.

motion.name: spring-interactive
motion.purpose: Card hover scale (1.02), interactive surface lift.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA and confirmation actions. Petroleum Dusk fill, light foreground.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: oklch(0.32 0.096 224); color: oklch(0.97 0.006 220); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.118 228); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 14px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Single most important action per screen. Bronze Bell fill. Never paired with Primary at equal weight.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: oklch(0.62 0.148 58); color: oklch(0.97 0.008 70); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { filter: brightness(0.9); } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.118 228); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 14px; } .ds-btn-accent:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions. Transparent with subtle border; fills muted on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.18 0.012 230); border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.01 220); border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.94 0.006 75); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.118 228); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary actions, toolbar icons, navigation icon-buttons. No border at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.18 0.012 230); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.94 0.006 75); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.118 228); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Primary container surface. Ambient petroleum-tinted shadow, subtle border, rounded-xl corners.
components.html:
Membros ativos
Congregação principal
Conteúdo do card aqui.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 20px; background: oklch(0.99 0.003 75); padding: 16px 0; color: oklch(0.18 0.012 230); font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.01 220 / 0.6); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px oklch(0.32 0.096 224 / 0.06), 0 4px 12px oklch(0.32 0.096 224 / 0.05); } .ds-card-header { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 0 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-description { font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.52 0.016 220); } .ds-card-content { padding: 0 16px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field with subtle border at rest, Bronze Bell focus ring — the system's signature tactile signal.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; width: 100%; min-width: 0; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.01 220 / 0.8); background: oklch(0.99 0.003 75); padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.18 0.012 230); transition: border-color 150ms ease-out; outline: none; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.52 0.016 220); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.62 0.148 58); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.62 0.148 58 / 0.2); } .ds-input:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; background: oklch(0.94 0.006 75 / 0.5); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Badge Primary
components.description: Status label and role indicator. Petroleum Dusk pill. Full pill radius, compact height.
components.css: .ds-badge-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; background: oklch(0.32 0.096 224); color: oklch(0.97 0.006 220); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Badge Outline
components.description: Neutral metadata tag. Transparent fill with border. Unselected filter pills.
components.css: .ds-badge-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.18 0.012 230); border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.01 220); border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Navigation item in the collapsible sidebar. Active state uses Petroleum Dusk tint background — no left border stripe.
components.html: Início
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.22 0.014 228); text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(0.92 0.012 220); color: oklch(0.28 0.068 224); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: oklch(0.92 0.012 220); color: oklch(0.28 0.068 224); } .ds-nav-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Koinos is built around the metaphor of an official parish register — not a software dashboard, but a dignified institutional record that a congregation trusts completely. The system is structured, legible, and warm: not warm in the decorative sense of gradients and rounded corners, but warm in the sense of a well-lit vestry, cream paper, and ink that doesn't bleed. Every screen should feel as if someone who cared deeply about the institution designed it, because they did.

The typography is the first handshake: Instrument Serif carries headings with quiet authority, the way official documents announce themselves without shouting. DM Sans takes the body — functional, contemporary, unhurried at 1.6 line-height. Together they span the congregation: legible for the 60-year-old pastor, modern enough for the 22-year-old worship coordinator. Color serves structure, not mood. Petroleum Dusk anchors interactive elements and navigation; Bronze Bell marks moments of attention with restrained warmth. The rest of the screen is Parchment Warm — a surface that reads as material, not void.

This system explicitly rejects four failure modes: static and outdated design reminiscent of Eklésia and its kind; heavy gospel aesthetics (gold, doves, religious iconography); the generic translated American SaaS look (identical rounded cards, blue gradients, vague copy); and anything that makes the non-technical user feel underestimated.
keyCharacteristics: Serif display + sans body pairing with tight negative tracking on headings
Three-tier tonal surface system (page → card → elevated) with warm temperature
Petroleum-tinted shadows — never black, never flat
Bronze Bell used sparingly: the accent earns its place through rarity
Motion via spring and ease-out only; no bounce, no elastic, no layout animation
WCAG AA contrast across all surfaces; multigenerational legibility is not optional

rules.name: The Bronze Bell Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Bronze Bell appears on at most two elements per screen: one interactive focus state and one highlighted action or status. Its warmth is only persuasive when it's rare. If it appears on three elements, rework one.

rules.name: The No-Black Rule
rules.body: Pure black (#000, oklch(0 0 0)) is never used. Every dark value carries the blue-teal lean of the primary hue (hue ~220–230). Check shadows, overlays, and icon fills.

rules.name: The One-Font-Per-Role Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif is for headings (h1, h2, h3, .font-display). DM Sans is for everything else. Never use Instrument Serif at label or body scale; never set a heading in DM Sans.

rules.name: The Negative-Tracking Rule
rules.body: Headings always carry negative letter-spacing (−0.01em to −0.02em). At display sizes, default tracking reads as loose and informal. Tight tracking is the editorial signature.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are never black. Every shadow value carries the Petroleum Dusk hue. If a shadow uses rgba(0,0,0,...) or #000, replace it with the petroleum tint.

rules.name: The Ambient-Not-Active Rule
rules.body: Shadow depth does not increase on hover for informational cards. Reserve shadow escalation for interactive surfaces that lift. A shadow appearing where it didn't exist is a stronger affordance signal than a deepening shadow.

dos: Do use Instrument Serif for h1, h2, h3, and .font-display elements.
Do keep Bronze Bell to at most two appearances per screen.
Do tint every shadow value toward Petroleum Dusk.
Do use the three-surface staircase (page → card → elevated) to communicate depth.
Do use negative letter-spacing on all display and headline text (−0.01em to −0.02em).
Do support both light and dark modes with separately designed token sets.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion via the safe() variant wrapper.
Do write every label, button, and heading in Portuguese Brazilian.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient.
Don't use glassmorphism as a default surface treatment.
Don't use pure black in shadows, overlays, or foreground colors.
Don't build the hero section as a big metric number, small label, supporting stats, gradient accent.
Don't design identical card grids with the same icon + heading + text structure repeated.
Don't reach for a modal as the first solution.
Don't import gospel aesthetic references: no gold as primary or accent, no dove iconography.
Don't reproduce the Eklésia design pattern: static pages, outdated visual language, no motion feedback.
Don't ship the generic translated American SaaS look: identical rounded cards, flat blue gradient headers, vague copy.
Don't underestimate the non-technical user: no technical vocabulary, no prior SaaS experience required.
